meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Maximum-saturation research orchestration: ALWAYS proposes the final materials first (PDF+DOCX default), then parallel explore+librarian swarms across codebase, web, official docs, and OSS repos — max-roster teammode when the harness has it — with live journaling, a recursive EXPAND loop driven by leads workers return in message text, empirical verification by running code, and a cited synthesis with charts/Mermaid/assets behind a mandatory visual-QA gate. ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user demand for research — the word 'ulw-research' in any prefix form, any 'ulw' research wording including combined invocations like 'mass ulw research', 'ultradebate' or 'hyperdebate' research requests, or an explicit request for research / deep research / an ultra-precise investigation, in any language. Never self-activates for ordinary questions, debugging, or implementation context-gathering. While active it overrides exploration-bounding defaults: exhaustive coverage is the goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对任意主题做多源深度调研并产出带引用报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常需要覆盖多来源、有引用支撑的深度研究报告。
copy.tagline_en: Orchestrate exhaustive multi-source research and produce cited synthesis reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need comprehensive research reports verified across many sources.

howto.what: 装上后,用户明确要求研究时,Claude进入“最大饱和研究”模式:先提出交付物(默认PDF+DOCX),再并行派探索小队查代码库、网页、官方文档等;用运行代码验证争议点,记日志,按线索循环扩展,产出带引用、图表且通过视觉质检的综合报告。
howto.when: 只有在用户明确要求研究时才触发,例如说出“ulw-research”、要求“深度研究”或提到“ultradebate”等(任何语言)。普通提问、调试或收集实现上下文不会激活。

say.text: ulw-research:Rust async runtime 最新基准差异。
say.note: 会派出探索小队跨仓库与网页查证,并用代码验证。

say.text: 做一次 ultradebate 研究:GPU 显存管理方案取舍。
say.note: 会安排至少两个对立视角辩论后再写结论。

howto.what_en: On explicit research request, Claude runs max-saturation research: proposes deliverable (PDF+DOCX default), spawns explorers, verifies claims by running code, logs live, expands leads, outputs a cited synthesis with charts after visual QA.
howto.when_en: Activates only on explicit research requests, e.g. "ulw-research", "deep research", or "ultradebate" (any language). Ordinary questions, debugging, or context-gathering never trigger it.

say_en.text: Use ulw-research for a deep dive: compare PostgreSQL and SQLite.
say_en.note: It will enter research mode and deliver a cited report.

say_en.text: ulw-research: investigate latest benchmark differences in Rust async runtimes.
say_en.note: Explorers cross-check repos/web, then verify by code.

say_en.text: Run an ultradebate research: GPU memory management trade-offs.
say_en.note: At least two opposing views debate before the conclusion.
